title: New template
description: Add a new template to the monorepo and CLI manifest.

items: Add app/ pages and lib/features/ for your domain
Define Prisma models in overlay prisma/schema.prisma (not Lead/PromoBanner)
Write README, GETTING_STARTED, ARCHITECTURE, CHANGELOG in overlay
Add pnpm dev:<id> script to root package.json if needed
Test with tempjs <id> in a temp folder

blocks.text: sync-templates.mjs reads template directories from templates.json automatically — no manual TEMPLATE_TARGETS list.
